::: {#rem-reducible-risk}
#### When the reducible risk is zero

The reducible risk is zero if and only if the prediction function $\predfn$ equals the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) with probability 1.

$$
\E{\sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}} = 0
\iff
\P(\predfnf{\Predvar} = \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}) = 1
$$

:::
